text: 据央视，贯彻落实党中央、国务院决策部署，近日，财政部会同农业农村部、水利部下达农业防灾减灾和水利救灾资金21.54亿元。一是支持广西、湖北、湖南、广东、重庆、贵州等6省（自治区、直辖市）开展水利工程设施水毁修复等洪涝、地震灾后救灾工作，助力保障水利工程安全运行。二是支持辽宁、吉林、浙江、广西、湖北等5省（自治区）开展在田作物肥水管理、绝收地块改种补种、畜牧渔业补栏补苗、损毁设施修复等灾后生产恢复工作。三是支持山西、新疆、甘肃等3省（自治区）及时做好农作物改种补种、畜牧补栏等洪涝、风雹灾后救灾工作，加快恢复农业生产。四是聚焦防救衔接，支持河北、内蒙古、吉林
text_en: According to CCTV, in implementing the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, the Ministry of Finance, together with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and the Ministry of Water Resources, recently allocated 2.154 billion yuan in agricultural disaster prevention, mitigation, and water conservancy disaster relief funds. First, supporting six provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities) including Guangxi, Hubei, Hunan, Guangdong, Chongqing, and Guizhou in carrying out flood and earthquake disaster relief work such as repairing damaged water conservancy facilities, helping ensure safe operation of water conservancy projects. Second, supporting five provinces (autonomous regions) including Liaoning, Jilin, Zhejiang, Guangxi, and Hubei in post-disaster production recovery work such as water and fertilizer management for standing crops, replanting and reseeding on failed plots, restocking livestock and aquaculture, and repairing damaged facilities. Third, supporting three provinces (autonomous regions) including Shanxi, Xinjiang, and Gansu in promptly carrying out post-disaster relief work from floods, hail, and wind disasters, including crop replanting and restocking livestock, to accelerate agricultural production recovery. Fourth, focusing on the integration of prevention and rescue, supporting Hebei, Inner Mongolia, and Jilin.
